HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 54-year-old male admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:

Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: bleeding duodenal ulcer, treated with endoscopic clips; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.87-1.9, hemoglobin 9.9-11, platelets 256-259, sodium 139, wbc 6.5-7.1; vitals dbp 74-78, heart_rate 77-82, map 92-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 128-133, spo2 96-98, temp 37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Transfuse 1 unit packed red blood cells
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 54-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week.
